construction: Defined in tools/corpus/make_toy_instances.m and written by MOSEK (mosekopt write, JTASK) from prob.a, c, blc, buc, blx, bux, f, g, accs; read back by mosekopt read, bit-for-bit equal to the written arrays.
derivation: Positive semidefinite cone of order 3 in svec form: F x = (x0, sqrt(2) x1, sqrt(2) x2, x3, sqrt(2) x4, x5) is svec of X = [x0 x1 x2; x1 x3 x4; x2 x4 x5] (lower triangle column by column). With x1 = 1, x2 = 0, x4 = 0 fixed, X = blkdiag([x0 1; 1 x3], x5) is PSD iff x5 >= 0, x0, x3 >= 0 and x0 x3 >= 1. Minimising trace(X) = x0 + x3 + x5: x5 = 0 and, by the arithmetic-geometric mean inequality, x0 + x3 >= 2 with equality only at x0 = x3 = 1; objective 2.
